general: Only when the source shows the ZAZO logo on the cream #f4ecdd background, keep one logo at about 18% of canvas width in its source position and let extra canvas go to the cream background, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows an orange #e8a13d circle with thin #c96f2e concentric rings behind the sunglasses, keep the circle at about 52% of canvas width behind the product and cropped only as in the source, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows dark #17323d sunglasses, keep them as a single horizontal silhouette overlapping the orange circle without recolouring or adding products, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows a dark #17323d rounded CTA panel, keep the panel at about 24% of canvas height with cream centred text inside and do not stretch it to fill extra space, otherwise keep the source structure.

Only when the source shows headline and subtext on cream, keep the headline bold #17323d above the smaller regular subtext and let extra height or width expand the cream and product area, otherwise keep the source structure.
Only when the source shows the cream #f4ecdd field as the full background, keep it flat and full-bleed with no added band or frame, otherwise keep the source structure.

never: Never add a second logo, extra brand mark, or watermark.
Never add extra bands, tabs, buttons, badges, or frames beyond the single dark CTA panel shown in the source.
Never add extra products, sunglasses styles, prices, or promotional text not visible in the source.
Never add gradients, photos, or background colours outside #17323d, #c96f2e, #e8a13d, and #f4ecdd.
